name: sanket
description: Sanket – Small Signals. Safer Spaces. (API + web app)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run env
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.start:prod: npm run build && npm start --prefix backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
